notes.title: Quick Note on Chinese Language Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is a quick warning regarding the current status of the chinese version of the game. Because the chinese and english version(s) are separate downloadable depots instead of a singular option within game, usually there are two versions of the game which download respectively depending on language options. It appears that at the moment, there is a major bug happening on Valve's end which has caused the chinese version to not download. when changing to chinese, it shows as downloaded (and with the correct file size - 73 MB), but it does not actually download from Steam. 

We have gone ahead and verified the backend is setup correctly, as well as testing this bug ourselves to verify it seems to be happening. Because of this, things are currently out of our hands, but we have reported the bug to Valve/Steam for fixing. Once it is is fixed we will update everyone. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Uncensor Patch & Guide To Install
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Thanks to cooperation with the developer and one our players, we were able to get an uncensor patch coordinated and released.

Please note that this contains sexual content and is not suitable for minors under the age of 18.

The patch can be downloaded from here:
http://tophatentertainment.us/patches/Game.rgssad

After downloading, find the Steam base folder, then "steamapps", then "common", then finally, "Girls and Dungeons". Select the downloaded file and move it to this directory, overwriting the existing file.

This should be all that is needed.

If you have any questions (or just want to chat), join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/Qphynem

or follow us on social media for updates:
